section_summary.extract_value: The introduction discusses the body image literature, noting a shift from a pathology-oriented focus to positive body image. It references four studies by Avalos et al. (2005) that validated the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) with women college students. The present study (Study X) aims to extend this work by developing and validating a German translation of the BAS with male and female community samples.
